EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT NOTE - Liffeyside General Hospital Triage 22/06/2082 06:12 ED doctor: Dr Marcin Kowalski Triage nurse: Rosa Moon Patient: Oksana HAVRYLENKO DOB 19/05/2061 Age @AGE@ MRN LGH 20-448193 Sex F Arrived by: ambulance, run sheet NAS-0622-5581 Cubicle R4 Dept selected: Orthopaedic Fracture Clinic
.CC 21 y.o. primigravida at 37 weeks + 3 days sent in by midwife Orla Wren from antenatal visit because BP 172/112 and headache since night. Husband no, partner Ruairi Keane with her. Contractions: none regular. Foetal movements present.
HPI: In the last three weeks she is followed in cardio-obstetric clinic for hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (dx 31/05/2082, in the system as eclampsia in pregnancy, but without seizure), admitted 31/05/2082 until 03/06/2082 on labetalol, discharged home with BP monitoring. Today headache bitemporal 7/10, no visual disturbance now, no epigastric pain, no vomiting, no chest pain, no dispnea. No fits. Pasted from previous note (cardiology 31/05/2082): "Dr. Villaverde, 21 years old woman, pregnant of 34 weeks + 2 days (EDD 30/06/2082) ... Labetalol per obstetric protocol". [EDD in this paragraph is wrong, corrected EDD is 10/07/2082] Pasted fragment: "Patient Mairead O'Donoghue, DOB 04/11/2059, MRN LGH 19-300177, known mitral stenosis, on warfarin, INR 2.4" <- this line is not our patient, from template.
PMH: fracture of left clavicle (09/2074), gingivitis, bronchitis, sinusitis, previous contraception. No allergies known. Meds now: labetalol 200 mg bd, no others, no aspirin. Social: lives Flat 4, 23 Thomond Road, Inchicore, Dublin 8, D08 K2F7, Ireland; works part time in a bakery (Delaney & Sons Bakery) until 34 weeks. Family: mother Halyna Havrylenko in Lviv, sister Daryna in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. Not smoke. Alcohol none.
Exam: T 36.8, HR 96, BP 168/110 and after 15 min 164/106, RR 18, SpO2 98% air. Alert, orientation OK, no focal neurology, no papilledema, tendon reflexes brisk with 2 beats clonus. Chest clear. Heart sounds normal, no murmur. Abdomen gravid, fundal height consistent with date, uterus soft, no tenderness. Oedema ++ both legs. Foetal heart rate 142 by Doppler. Investigations: urine protein 3+; bloods sent (FBC, U&E, LFT, urate, clotting); ECG sinus rhythm 94, no ischaemic change. No imaging needed. Treatment: IV labetalol 20 mg, then magnesium sulphate per protocol started 06:50 on advice of obstetrician Prof Niamh Brannigan.
Impression: Severe pre-eclampsia at term. No evidence of Bell's palsy or other focal deficit (patient asked because she feel mouth heavy on the left, exam ok, symmetric). Disposition: transferred to labour ward LW 3 at 07:25 for induction of labour (medical induction), handed over to registrar Dr Sinead Gallagher. Partner informed, he phone mother of patient Halyna +380 32 555 0178.
Electronically signed M. Kowalski 22/06/2082 08:03 - Last edited by mkowalski 22/06/2082 09:41 from 172.20.31.77
